envelope.description: analyze.classify refuses a scope before returning a size

body.title: analyze.classify refuses a scope before returning a size
body.summary: src/daemon/analyze-rpc.ts: after the classifier names the scope and before measureRequestScope, the request runs resolveTaskScope for a non-generic target and ensureRepoQueryable for every non-generic source; a refused scope is answered with its code and message through scopeErrorMapping and no size. Grounding: src/daemon/analyze-rpc.ts:347-348 calls the classifier and then measureRequestScope with no scope check between them.
acceptanceChecks: analyze.classify on an unindexed scope answers 'scope-not-indexed' with today's message and returns no measured size.
On a repository under index it answers 'repo-indexing'.

tests.name: analyze.classify on an unindexed scope answers 'scope-not-indexed' and returns no measured size; on a repository under index, 'repo-indexing'
